newsitem.title: SPAIN: British man gored in Spain's Pamplona bull run.
newsitem.headline: British man gored in Spain's Pamplona bull run.

text.p: A British man was slightly hurt on Wednesday after being gored in the arm during a bull run on the third day of Spain's famous San Fermin festival in Pamplona, emergency services officials said.
Derek White, 28, of Portsmouth, England, was the first foreigner injured this year. An American was killed at the festival two years ago after being gored in the abdomen.
Pamplona's bull run, in which hundreds of people run through the city's narrow, cobbled streets ahead of six half-tonne fighting bulls, attracts tourists from around the world.

Officials said the run on Wednesday, in which 16 other people were hurt, was particularly dangerous because the roads were wet from rain and the bulls slipped, fell and got separated. One bull created panic when he turned back from the bull ring and into the crowd of runners.
